questions.prompt: Which sentence tells about sunlight in Day and Night?

Earth rotates all day and night.
The cycle repeats as Earth turns.
questions.answer: Sunlight brightens one side of Earth.

questions.prompt: What does Earth do all day and night?

Earth stops all day and night.
Earth shrinks all day and night.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Day and Night?
choices: The cycle repeats as Earth turns.
Only sunlight brightens one side of Earth.
Only Earth rotates all day and night.
questions.answer: The cycle repeats as Earth turns.
questions.rationale: Sunlight brightens one side of Earth. Earth rotates all day and night. The cycle repeats as Earth turns. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: The cycle repeats as Earth turns.
